item.title: Lady Panthers struggle offensively in loss against Christian Fellowship
item.description: Prairie Home girls’ basketball coach Katie Robb said overall the Lady Panthers never got in any rhythm Monday night in a 43-25 loss against Christian Fellowship.

item.title: Bunceton falls on the road against Community
item.description: The Bunceton boys’ and girls’ basketball team had a tough night offensively while losing to Community in a doubleheader at Community 64-23 and 77-37, respectively.

item.title: New Franklin falls at home against Fatima
item.description: The New Franklin boys’ and girls’ basketball team had one of those nights against the Fatima Comets Tuesday night in New Franklin.

item.title: Boonville wrestlers close out home schedule with quad on Senior Night
item.description: On the final night for the senior wrestlers at the Windsor Gymnasium, Boonville wrestling coach Justin Hahn had one word for not just the four seniors but the entire team in a quadrangular against Oak Grove, St. James and Southern Boone: fight.

item.title: HISTORICALLY YOURS
item.description: In the beginning, Pennsylvania’s legislative assembly met in private homes which were rented by the year. In 1729, plans began to build a state house in Philadelphia which was the capital of the Province of Pennsylvania. A committee of three—Thomas Lawrence, John Kearsley, and Andrew Hamilton—was created to select a site for the building, acquire plans for it, and contract a company for its construction. Hamilton and William Allen were named trustees and authorized to purchase the land.

item.title: Council approves agreement with county officials for tax collection
item.description: Each year, the City and the County enter into an agreement for the Cooper County Clerk to extend the taxes for the City and for the Cooper County Collector to collect said taxes.
